attribution_context_evidence.raw_text:
There are two functions that can parse semantic versions. The `StrictNewVersion`
function only parses valid version 2 semantic versions as outlined in the
specification. The `NewVersion` function attempts to coerce a version into a
semantic version and parse it. For example, if there is a leading v or a version
listed without all 3 parts (e.g. 1.2) it will attempt to coerce it into a valid
semantic version (e.g., 1.2.0). In both cases a `Version` object is returned
that can be sorted, compared, and used in constraints.

critical_semantic_assessment.bounded_contextual_coverage: Supported for the optional-v permission/rejection property if the frozen candidate binding explicitly instantiates the capability as NewVersion and the request targets only v1.2.3. The whole bullet says the library can optionally work with a v prefix; doc.go immediately identifies NewVersion as the coercing parse path including leading v. The actual source uses the optional-v regex on its default coercing path. Strict digit-only parsing and the valid-v2 restriction give the opposite property for this fixed input.
critical_semantic_assessment.caption_alone_API_guarantee: Unsupported: the bullet names no function and does not promise every semver API accepts v, all v-prefixed strings succeed, or return/error/String/panic fields.
critical_semantic_assessment.material_gap_if_binding_is_omitted: A generic package capability is not automatically a faithful description of an arbitrary function. Keep coverage unresolved if the runtime candidate-to-NewVersion mapping is absent or only asserted by this report.
critical_semantic_assessment.not_a_readiness_gate: This is a narrower source/text contract proposal, not an execution pass, new supervision label, author-diversity approval or training-readiness decision.
